title: Export and restore ratings so curation survives a reseed
description:
Star ratings (Rating: sample/clip/score, 0-5, one per person, owner-only) live only in the cloud backend (web/amplify/data/resource.ts; import-library.ts CLOUD_ONLY). They are not in library folders, git or sync, so reseeding from git loses the user's curation; cloning production keeps it.

Add a tracked export the seed can restore: a command (or script) that signs in as a curator, reads the caller's Ratings and writes a deterministic file keyed by stable target ids (recording/path, not random ids), plus a restore that writes them back into a seeded backend. Same read path serves the one-star prune utility (apricitus-f26c20), so design them together: one Rating reader, two consumers. Decide the file format and location (tracked in git, small), and how targets map after a reseed (sample ids hash the audio bytes, so a .clean.wav has a different id than its original: map by catalog path).
Spec first. Needs curator credentials; the user signs in, the agent does not handle passwords.
